title: Bringing Multi-Chain Users From Ctrl Wallet Into Cardano

ms.promise:
A. Enable full Cardano native asset support within CTRL Wallet, allowing users to hold, send, and receive ADA and all Cardano-native tokens.
B. Update backend to handle token metadata, transaction parsing, and UTXO management.
C. Update UI to display native assets with token icons, balances, and fiat values.
D. Conduct QA testing to validate send/receive accuracy and metadata rendering.
E. Prepare documentation for backend and frontend integration.
Please Note: These features will be live in production for all users globally on iOS, Android and Chrome Extension. Anybody can independently verify functionality by simply downloading Ctrl Wallet (free application) and testing.

D1. Balances and histories sync correctly with Cardano node data.
E1. Detailed QA report verifying successful native asset transactions including tests run and success rates.
